title: Strawberry Wrap
description: A sweet and savory Peruvian-inspired wrap with juicy strawberries and crispy xtra ingredients.

ingredients.name: Tangy Guacamole
ingredients.notes: ripe avocado blended with lime juice and salt

instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
Place the wrap in the pan and cook for 30 seconds.
Flip the wrap over and spread the tangy guacamole on the bottom half.
Add sliced strawberries on top of the guacamole.
Sprinkle xtra crispy and Peruvian pepper flakes over the strawberries.
Fold the top half of the wrap over the filling.
